description: Where a price sits: the cheapest, typical (median) and priciest qualified unit price for the same item across stores near a place on a day (flyer offers valid that day, shelf prices read within a week), how many prices each rests on, and `status` ranged | thin_range | unranged. Give quantity, unit and paidMinor to get the percentile and savings for a price. Use it before a purchase to say what a fair price is; record_purchases stores the same numbers.

item.description: The generic item, as compare_items takes it: "chicken thighs", "large eggs", "bananas". Not a brand or receipt code.

near.description: Where the shopper is: a Canadian postal code ("M6H 2B6"), an FSA ("M6H"), or "lat,lng".

paidMinor.description: A price paid or planned for `quantity`, in cents.

unit.description: Unit of `quantity`; also picks the unit prices compare in (kg, L or each).

name: price_range
title: Price range for an item
